name: get_background_info
description: Retrieve a specific background detail that is not already covered by the built-in profile brief, such as an exact resume date or a precise project detail.

name: get_availability
description: Fetch real calendar availability for the next 7 days. Use only for explicit scheduling or booking requests, and pass the caller's scheduling request so the backend can filter the options.

name: book_meeting
description: Book a meeting only after confirming one exact slot from the available options. Pass the caller's exact confirmation words in selection and do not invent a new date.

name: get_github_info
description: Get deep technical details about one specific named GitHub repository.
